summary: Indian shares face a weak start on Thursday after their strong rebound, as Wall Street sinks on hotter US inflation, a renewed chip rout and new US tariff proposals that include India.

detail.leaders: FMCG and banks led today's rebound; their follow-through is the first test
detail.laggards: Metals led by Tata Steel were weak, and US tech stocks are selling off hard
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for Thursday. Clearly softer than the previous note: the US sell-off has deepened since then, and India now faces a proposed tariff of up to 25%.
watch: How far the US sell-off runs before Thursday's Thanksgiving close
